cases.sentence: Приведу я против тебя Навуходоносара, ___ вавилонского.
cases.translation: I will bring Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, against you.
cases.explain: Царя is in apposition with the accusative object of приведу.

cases.sentence: С конницею и с пехотою и со станом ___.
cases.translation: With cavalry and with infantry and with a great army.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Построит против ___ стены и сделает вал.
cases.translation: He will build siege walls against you and make a siege ramp.
cases.explain: Тебя as a pronoun is the direct object of the preposition против.

cases.sentence: И построит против тебя ___ и сделает вал против тебя.
cases.translation: And he will build siege walls against you and construct a siege ramp.
cases.explain: Стены is the direct object of построит.

cases.sentence: Со стороны северной приведу я Навуходоносора с ___.
cases.translation: From the north I will bring Nebuchadnezzar with cavalry.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Построит стены и сделает ___ против тебя.
cases.translation: He will build walls and make a siege ramp against you.
cases.explain: Вал is the direct object of сделает.

cases.sentence: И поднимет против тебя ___ и сделает вал.
cases.translation: And he will lift his shield against you and make a siege ramp.
cases.explain: Щит is the direct object of поднимет.

cases.sentence: С севера с конницею и с пехотою и со станом ___.
cases.translation: From the north with cavalry and infantry and with a great host.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: И приведу я против тебя Навуходоносора, царя вавилонского, с севера.
reading.question: From which direction will Nebuchadnezzar attack Tyre?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Nebuchadnezzar will come 'from the north.'

reading.ru: И построит против тебя стены и сделает вал против тебя и поднимет против тебя щит.
reading.question: What military tactics will be used against Tyre?
options: Building siege walls, making siege ramps, and raising shields
reading.correct: Building siege walls, making siege ramps, and raising shields
reading.explain: The passage describes the construction of siege works including walls, ramps, and the raising of shields.

reading.ru: С конницею и с пехотою и со станом великим.
reading.question: What forces will Nebuchadnezzar bring with him?
options: Cavalry, infantry, and a great army
reading.correct: Cavalry, infantry, and a great army
reading.explain: The text specifically mentions cavalry (конница), infantry (пехота), and a great army (стан великий).

reading.ru: Навуходоносора, царя вавилонского, с севера с конницею и с пехотою.
reading.question: Who is the military leader that God will send against Tyre?
reading.explain: The text names Nebuchadnezzar specifically as the king of Babylon who will be sent by God.

reading.ru: И построит против тебя стены и сделает вал против тебя.
reading.question: What will be built and constructed against Tyre?
reading.explain: The text describes the construction of стены (walls) and вал (siege ramp/embankment).

reading.ru: И поднимет против тебя щит и сделает вал против тебя.
reading.question: What defensive measures will be employed in the siege?
options: Shields will be raised and a siege ramp will be made
reading.correct: Shields will be raised and a siege ramp will be made
reading.explain: The verse explicitly mentions the raising of щит (shields) and construction of вал (ramp).
